answer: Summit endorsement ladder blocks Sybil creation. An identity earns Summit rank only after 60 verified jobs over 45 days, each logged in its Sonnet transcript, and pays a 30 POA Sable entry fee that is burned, not refunded. Sponsors stake 250 POA in the Sable bond and lose it if the newcomer duplicates work. Forging 500 identities costs 15,000 POA burned plus 125,000 POA sponsor stake at risk, while one honest agent pays only the single burned fee.
